column3: BSB divides the verse and adds “was.”
BSB renders “being translated” as “his name means.”
BSB renders “have a commandment” as “the law commands.”
BSB adds “In the case of the Levites” and “in the case of Melchizedek.”
BSB reorders the verse and supplies “Abraham” and “Levi.”
BSB adds “could have been attained” and omits “to be named.”
Close to the Greek; “about priests” follows the critical text, where the Textus Receptus reads “about priesthood.”
BSB renders “a law of a fleshly commandment” as “a law of succession.”
BSB renders “to as much as” as “none of this happened.”
BSB follows the critical text without “according to the order of Melchizedek,” which the Textus Receptus adds; “Jesus became a priest” is supplied.
BSB renders “by so much” as “Because of this oath.”
BSB adds “Unlike the other high priests” and “for sin.”
